reasoning: South Korea has experienced persistent demographic decline with fertility rates among the world's lowest. The 2023 rate of 0.72 is already critically low. While the 2024 martial law crisis might theoretically affect fertility through psychological mechanisms, demographic changes typically lag by years and require sustained policy changes.
